title: AWS Community Day Bandung 2026
description:
AWS User Group Bandung
**Meetup RSVP is not your event registration.**
To attend AWS Community Day Bandung 2026, you need to register through our official event page. Seats are limited, and every registration is reviewed before approval.

🔗 **Get your ticket:**
[https://bandung.awscommunity.id/comday/](https://bandung.awscommunity.id/comday/)

**AWS Community Day Bandung 2026**
📅 **Saturday, 7 November 2026**
⏰ **09.00 – 16.00 WIB**
📍 **Auditorium SBM ITB**
Gedung Labtek XIX Lt. 6, Jl. Ganesa No. 10, Bandung

**The format**
🎤 **Tech Talks**
Technical sessions and Q&A with community practitioners throughout the day.
🛠️ **Hands-on Workshops**
After lunch, three classrooms open for guided hands-on sessions where you can build, configure, and experiment alongside other participants.
🤝 **Meet the community**
Connect with builders from Bandung and beyond, exchange ideas, and meet the people behind the community.
🎁 **More on the day**
Selected participants will have the chance to receive giveaways.

**🎤 Want to take the stage?**
Community Day is built by the community. **Share what you built, what broke, and what you learned.**
You don't need to be an AWS Hero. First-time speakers are especially welcome.
Session formats:

* **Technical Session — 40 minutes**
* **Lightning Talk — 15 minutes**
* **Hands-on Workshop — 90 minutes**

👉 **Submit a session:**
[https://sessionize.com/aws-community-day-bandung-2026](https://sessionize.com/aws-community-day-bandung-2026)
📅 **Closes 20 October 2026, 23.59 WIB**

Travel support is available for selected speakers from Jabodetabek and West Java. Details will be shared with accepted speakers.

**From the community. Run by the community. For the community.**

title: AWS User Group Bandung Meetup - September 2026
description:
